quotes.text: Allow customers to securely make payments using Apple Pay on their Apple device.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: There are no additional fees to process Apple Pay payments, and [pricing](https://stripe.com/pricing/local-payment-methods#apple-pay) is the same as for other card transactions.
In other regions, your app can’t accept Apple Pay for digital products, content, or subscriptions.
One CSR file must be used to issue exactly one certificate.
To use Apple Pay, you must register all of your web domains that show an Apple Pay button with Apple.
To test Apple Pay, you must use a real credit card number and your test [API keys](https://docs.stripe.com/keys.md).

findings: The same canonical URL changed from a 906-line combined guide (old lines 4-906) to a 15-line variant index (new lines 5-15).
